# TrueMatix

> TrueMatix provides two things: a product-authentication platform and a
> managed online brand protection service.
>
> The platform gives each physical product a unique cryptographically signed QR
> identity, lets customers verify it on a verification page branded as the
> brand's own, and analyses scan patterns to surface suspected counterfeiting
> and grey-market diversion.

Market: consumer brands, primarily GCC. Sectors described on the site:
cosmetics, supplements, electronics, apparel, luxury goods.

## Pages
- [Homepage](https://www.truematix.com/): product overview, how it works, AI
  detection capabilities, dashboard, demo request.
- [Online brand protection](https://www.truematix.com/online-brand-protection/):
  additional service, separate from the platform — marketplace, social and
  lookalike-domain monitoring, analyst triage, authorised platform reporting.

## What the product does
- Issues one signed, unique code per item; codes are assigned to batches,
  markets and distributors at shipment.
- Verification pages are white-labelled to the brand.
- Scan analysis flags duplicate serials, geographically implausible scan
  sequences, and volume spikes.
- Out-of-market scan clusters are traced back to the batch and distributor
  assignment they originated from.
- Alerts are delivered when flags are raised.

## Online brand protection — managed service
One of two offerings from TrueMatix. It is NOT a feature of the authentication
software and does not appear in the verification dashboard; findings are
delivered as reports. Scoped and priced separately from the platform, and
either works on its own. Monitoring, evidence capture and recurrence tracking
run in a separate AI monitoring program, distinct from the scan-analysis AI;
triage, authorised platform reporting and case
follow-up are performed by analysts. Channel coverage is agreed per engagement
and is not universal. Reports are filed as the brand's authorised agent, on the
brand's approval, through each platform's own rights-holder process. Removal
decisions rest with the platform; takedowns are not guaranteed.

## Limitations stated by the vendor
- A printed QR code can be photographed and reproduced. The system detects
  duplicate use of a serial; it does not prevent copying.
- An out-of-market scan cluster indicates where product surfaced. It is an
  investigative lead, not proof of liability.
- Detection depends on customers scanning. Unscanned product is unobserved.
